message.content: {"edits":[{"op":"set_pin","component":"Q7","pin":"Base","net":"vb","why":"Q7 base connects to the VB bias line, not to the input-pair emitter node"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"Q7","pin":"Emitter","net":"vee","why":"Q7 emitter goes to -5V, not to the tail node"},{"op":"add_component","type":"NPN","pins":{"Collector":"net7","Base":"vb","Emitter":"vee"},"why":"The tail current source transistor (Q6 in the image) was missed"}]}
message.reasoning:
I'm working out which pipeline components map to which labels on the schematic, since the netlist IDs don't line up with the image. I'm locating each transistor by its bounding box, and one PNP looks diode-connected, so I'm checking how its base and collector are tied.

I'm checking the transistor at around (210, 200-265) and tracing its emitter to the base bus, its base to the collector lines, and its collector to ground, which makes it the pipeline's Q3. I'm then matching the other pipeline PNPs and NPNs to their image labels by collector, base and emitter nets, and I notice Q7's base and emitter don't match what they should be.

I'm tracing the tail transistor's connections next: its collector sits on the common emitter net, with base on VB and emitter on -5V. That means Q7's base and emitter are both tied to the same net, which is wrong, so I'm reassigning Q7's base to VB and its emitter to the negative rail, and adding the missing NPN tail component.
